tasks.label: GameWIP: Run Development With Startup Tests
GameWIP: Profile
tasks.command: cmake --preset profile; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cmake --build --preset profile --parallel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $profiler = 'C:\MSYS2\GameWIPTools\tools\tracy\tracy-profiler.exe'; if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $profiler)) { throw 'Matching Tracy profiler tools are missing; run setup.bat profiler.' }; if ($null -eq (Get-Process -Name tracy-profiler -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Process -FilePath $profiler -WorkingDirectory (Split-Path $profiler) }; & '${workspaceFolder}\build\profile\GameWIP.exe'
